question: Estimate the unique reach of an in-app push notification campaign sent to 5 crore Swiggy users.
idealClarificationQuestions: Single push notification to entire active user base? Yes.
Reach = users who actually saw the notification on their phone? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Push notification delivery rate (notifications enabled, app installed, online): ~75% = 3.75 crore delivered.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Notification 'seen' rate (lock screen / pull-down / app icon badge): ~65% of delivered = ~2.4 crore.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Notification 'seen' rate (lock screen / pull-down / app icon badge)

calculationFlow: Push notification delivery rate (notifications enabled, app installed, online): ~75% = 3.75 crore delivered.
Notification 'seen' rate (lock screen / pull-down / app icon badge): ~65% of delivered = ~2.4 crore.
Open rate (tapped through to app): ~3-5% of delivered = ~12-19 lakh.
